name: qlrisk_price_abs
title: Price a ABS
description:
Price one Asset-Backed Securities (qlrisk ABS).
Inputs (* required, name=default): maturity*, face_value=100, spread_bp=100, coupon_pct=5, cpr_pct=10, currency=USD. In `advanced` also: effective_date, issuer, position.
Example: {"maturity": "5Y", "face_value": 100} gives NPV 99.43 USD (sample market valued 2026-10-09).
